card.name: Broken bytes of non-Latin characters
card.fires_on: Responds to a partial byte piece of a non-Latin character (such as Chinese or a curly quote) that appears mid-character. Fires strongest on the first piece of a Chinese character after Latin transliteration, and weakly on other broken character pieces.
